name: Dual-Stack Runtime Detection & Serving Protocol
description: When inspecting scaffolded or delivered project packages, analyze whether the archive is a framework project (containing package.json) or a clean static web package (HTML, CSS, JS assets). Never invent or force an unnecessary React/Next.js framework scaffolding if the delivered project is already a complete, fast static site; conversely, never flatten an existing React/Next.js component structure into static HTML.
designPhilosophy: When inspecting scaffolded or delivered project packages, analyze whether the archive is a framework project (containing package.json) or a clean static web package (HTML, CSS, JS assets)
implementationApproach: Always serve static web packages through a local HTTP server rather than raw file:// protocol to ensure ES module imports, SVG clip-path filters, Web Audio, and asset paths resolve cleanly.
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
